apiKeys.intro: API Keys allow you to access Onyx APIs programmatically. Click the button below to generate a new API Key.
apiKeys.newKeyModalDescription: Make sure you copy your new API key. You won’t be able to see this key again.
apiKeys.formIntro: Choose a memorable name for your API key. This is optional and can be added or changed later!
apiKeys.roleSubtext: Select the role for this API key. Limited has access to simple public API's. Basic has access to regular user API's. Admin has access to admin level APIs.

tokenRateLimits.intro: Token rate limits enable you control how many tokens can be spent in a given time period. With token rate limits, you can:
tokenRateLimits.bulletGlobal: Set a global rate limit to control your team's overall token spend.
tokenRateLimits.bulletUser: Set rate limits for users to ensure that no single user can spend too many tokens.
tokenRateLimits.bulletUserGroup: Set rate limits for user groups to control token spend for your teams.
tokenRateLimits.bulletToggle: Enable and disable rate limits on the fly.
tokenRateLimits.descGlobal: Global rate limits apply to all users, user groups, and API keys. When the global rate limit is reached, no more tokens can be spent.
tokenRateLimits.descUser: User rate limits apply to individual users. When a user reaches a limit, they will be temporarily blocked from spending tokens.
tokenRateLimits.descUserGroup: User group rate limits apply to all users in a group. When a group reaches a limit, all users in the group will be temporarily blocked from spending tokens, regardless of their individual limits. If a user is in multiple groups, the most lenient limit will apply.

settingsForm.autoScrollHint: If set, the chat window will automatically scroll to the bottom as new lines of text are generated by the AI model. This can be overridden by individual user settings.

settingsForm.imageExtractionHint: Extract and analyze images from documents during indexing. This allows the system to process images and create searchable descriptions of them.
settingsForm.searchTimeImageHint: Analyze images at search time when a user asks about images. This provides more detailed and query-specific image analysis but may increase search-time latency.
settingsForm.maxImageSizeMbHint: Images larger than this size will not be analyzed to prevent excessive resource usage.
settingsForm.defaultVisionLlmHint: Select the default LLM to use for image analysis. This model will be utilized during image indexing and at query time for search results, if the above settings are enabled.
